Title: Network without physics
Description: Same network trained on the sensor labels only (no physics-only boards, beta = gamma = 0)

Para.Name: Space functions
Para.Description: number of space functions phi_k (trunk outputs) and time constants tau_k per chip

Para.Name: Trunk width
Para.Description: neurons per hidden layer of the trunk network

Para.Name: Trunk depth
Para.Description: number of hidden layers of the trunk network

Para.Name: Fourier frequencies
Para.Description: Fourier frequencies per coordinate of the trunk input

Para.Name: Relative coordinates
Para.Description: (1): coordinates relative to every chip as trunk inputs, (0): absolute coordinates only

Para.Name: Maximum time constant
Para.Description: upper limit of the time constants: lambda_k >= 1/tauCap

Para.Name: Data weight
Para.Description: weight of the data loss (labels at the sensor nodes)

Para.Name: Physics weight
Para.Description: weight of the physics loss (finite-volume residual of the physics-only boards; 0: no physics)

Para.Name: Steady-state weight
Para.Description: weight of the steady-state loss (sum of phi_k equals G^-1 Bp; 0: off)

Para.Name: Physics-only boards
Para.Description: (1): use the physics-only boards (physics and steady-state loss), (0): labelled boards only

Para.Name: Epochs
Para.Description: maximum number of epochs

Para.Name: Patience
Para.Description: early stopping after pat epochs without improvement of the validation RMSE (at the sensors)

Para.Name: Steps per epoch
Para.Description: optimiser steps per epoch

Para.Name: Learning rate
Para.Description: initial learning rate of Adam (halved after 5 epochs without improvement)

Para.Name: Gradient clipping
Para.Description: maximum norm of the gradient

Para.Name: Seed
Para.Description: random seed (initialisation, sampling)

Para.Name: Sampling time
Para.Description: sampling time of the profiles

Para.Name: Data boards per step
Para.Description: labelled profiles per optimiser step

Para.Name: Physics boards per step
Para.Description: physics-only boards per optimiser step

Para.Name: Residual nodes
Para.Description: nodes of the physics residual per board and step

Para.Name: Steady-state boards
Para.Description: boards per step of the steady-state loss

Para.Name: Physics profile length
Para.Description: length of the random loss profiles of the physics loss

Para.Name: Minimum hold time
Para.Description: minimum hold time of the random loss profiles of the physics loss

Para.Name: Maximum hold time
Para.Description: maximum hold time of the random loss profiles of the physics loss

Para.Name: G^-1 cache
Para.Description: boards of the physics loss with G^-1 in memory (dense 4 N^2 bytes, or nR rows 4 nR N bytes per board above nDense nodes)

Para.Name: Cache renewal
Para.Description: boards of the cache replaced per epoch

Para.Name: Dense limit
Para.Description: boards with more nodes keep only nR rows of G^-1 (sparse LU) instead of the dense inverse
